intended_use: Linear-elastic screening of explicit infill geometry before physical coupon tests

screening_isotropic.nu_provenance: User-supplied initialization prior; not measured in the cited dataset

reported_strength_reference.interpretation: Reference limit only. The linear-elastic solver does not predict failure.

sources.note: Reported overall elastic modulus and tensile strength; associated raw workbook has documented label/count conflicts.
Density, Poisson ratios, shear moduli, and TDS-style directional initialization values supplied in the project brief.

limitations: The cited print-placement orientations are not a complete verified mapping to local bead, transverse-bead, and build axes.
Compression strength, fatigue, creep, layer debonding, nonlinear post-buckling, and fracture are not represented.
Pattern rankings have solid-mesh screening but still require confirmation with printed coupons.
